disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Activity is meaningfully ahead of price: the divergence is 3.732, with fused acceleration of 2.001 across seven sources [P2][P3]. The strongest signals are a lobbying ramp (1.236), congressional net buying (1.19), federal contracts (0.635), and accelerating news flow [P3][P5]. Persistence is less certain because grant opportunities are only mildly positive, pre-award solicitations are negative, and all measured news is unscheduled, which may indicate event-driven bursts rather than a steady pipeline [P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed the narrative—60-day relative performance is deeply negative—so the emerging setup merits monitoring until procurement indicators or price improve [P1][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 实际活动明显领先价格：活动与价格的背离为3.732，且七类来源的综合加速度达到2.001 [P2][P3]。主要支撑来自游说升温、国会议员净买入、联邦合同及加速的新闻流 [P3][P5]。但持续性仍不确定，因为联邦资助机会仅小幅为正，招标前活动为负，而且新闻全部属于非计划事件，可能反映阶段性冲量而非稳定项目管线 [P3][P5]。过去60天的相对价格表现显著落后，尚未确认这一新兴趋势，因此应继续观察采购活动或价格能否改善 [P1][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, lobbying, insider policy-related buying and news activity are all picking up, while prices have continued to lag the market sharply. That gap could create an opportunity, but weak early-stage procurement and grant signals make it unclear whether the pickup will persist. Keep watching for stronger project pipelines or a sustained price recovery before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同、游说活动、政策相关人士买入和新闻热度都在上升，但相关公司的价格仍明显落后于整体市场。这种落差可能带来机会，不过前期采购和资助信号仍弱，当前升温能否持续尚不明确。宜继续观察项目储备是否增强，或价格能否持续回升，再考虑投入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case for entering now is that activity leads price by an unusually large margin, while acceleration is positive across seven tracked sources; waiting for price confirmation could sacrifice the early-stage advantage [P1][P2][P3].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next update cycles, pre-award solicitations and grant opportunities turn clearly positive while federal contracts, lobbying, and news acceleration remain positive, and relative price performance begins improving [P3][P4][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Fused acceleration falls toward or below zero, lobbying and contract signals fade, or relative performance remains deeply negative despite continued news activity [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price (divergence z=1.493), with strong pre-award solicitations (z=1.49) and regulatory pipeline activity (z=1.402), plus modest congressional buying and lobbying support [P2][P3]. Durability is promising but not established: acceleration is high (2.178) and signals span seven sources, yet material 8-K events are negative (z=-0.928), grants and news are neutral, and the theme remains emerging [P1][P3]. Continuity is weak because 60-day relative strength is negative (-11.34%; z=-1.049) despite improving activity [P4]. News is accelerating and entirely unscheduled, which may provide a catalyst, but current velocity is only 1.2 and price confirmation is absent [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动明显领先于价格：前期采购征询和监管推进信号较强，国会净买入与游说活动也提供了较温和的支持[P2][P3]。持续性具有潜力但尚未得到充分验证，因为综合活动正在加速且覆盖七类来源，但重大公司事件偏弱，联邦拨款与新闻信号仍为中性，主题也仍处于早期[P1][P3]。价格尚未确认，过去60天相对大盘表现落后11.34%[P4]。新闻活动有所加速且全部属于非预定事件，可能形成催化剂，但当前新闻强度有限[P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: 政府采购前期征询和监管推进正在明显升温，国会交易与游说活动也略有改善，但企业重大事项、拨款和新闻尚未形成一致支持。相关股票过去60天落后大盘约11%，说明价格还没有认可这股活动回升。值得继续观察，但在更多实际项目落地或价格转强前，不宜急于介入。
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府采购前期征询和监管推进明显升温，国会交易与游说活动也略有改善，但企业重大事项、拨款和新闻尚未形成一致支持。相关股票过去60天落后大盘约11%，说明价格仍未确认现实活动的回升。可以继续观察，但在更多项目落地或价格转强前不宜急于介入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish dissent is that activity leads price by 1.493 standard deviations while pre-award solicitations and the regulatory pipeline are both unusually strong; with fused acceleration at 2.178, weak relative performance could represent an early entry window rather than a warning [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if the next observation shows pre-award solicitations and regulatory activity remaining positive, material 8-K events improving from negative, and 60-day relative performance turning positive [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if pre-award solicitations or regulatory pipeline activity falls back toward neutral while fused acceleration fades and relative performance remains negative [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
assessments.name_zh: 半导体设备（晶圆厂设备）

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully positive: government-contract activity is strongest at 1.977, lobbying is elevated at 1.107, and congressional net buying is positive at 0.664, producing fused acceleration of 1.695 across four sources [P3]. Durability is plausible but unproven because the signal spans several sources, yet the theme is only forming, material 8-K events are flat-to-negative, and there is no news leg [P1][P3][P5]. Price offers partial confirmation: 60-day relative strength is positive but modest, while activity remains ahead of price by 0.71 [P2][P4]. With coverage limited to two members, the apparent confirmation may not represent the full sector, supporting MONITOR rather than ENTER [P6].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号明显偏强：政府合同活动最突出，游说活动升温，国会议员净买入也为正，四个来源合成后的加速读数较高[P3]。这一趋势可能持续，但尚未得到充分验证，因为主题仍处于形成阶段，重大8-K事件略偏负面，而且没有新闻推动[P1][P3][P5]。价格在过去60天相对市场小幅走强，但现实活动仍领先于价格，说明市场仅部分确认了该叙事[P2][P4]。此外，覆盖范围仅有两个成分股，因此更适合继续观察，而非立即进入[P6]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, lobbying and congressional buying are all picking up for the covered consumer-staples companies, suggesting genuine activity beneath the theme. Prices have begun to outperform the market, but only modestly, and there is no supporting news momentum or clear rise in major corporate events. Because the signal is still early and covers only two companies, investors should keep watching rather than act immediately.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 所覆盖的必需消费品公司在政府合同、游说活动和国会议员买入方面均有所升温，说明这一主题背后存在真实活动。相关公司近期表现略好于大盘，但优势并不明显，同时缺少新闻推动，重大公司事件也没有明显增加。由于趋势仍处早期且只覆盖两家公司，目前更适合继续观察，而不是立即行动。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that three independent activity sources are positive, led by unusually strong government-contract activity, while price has only modestly responded; this could be an early entry window rather than a reason to wait [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the MONITOR stance if the next readings show activity remaining positive across government contracts, lobbying and congressional buying while relative price strength stays only modest and no news leg emerges [P3][P4][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it in favor of ENTER if multi-source activity remains elevated or accelerates and relative price strength clearly improves; disconfirm it in favor of AVOID if the positive contract, lobbying and congressional signals fade or reverse without stronger price confirmation [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real activity is improving at the aggregate level, with fused acceleration of 1.436, but participation is uneven: congressional net buying is strong and the regulatory pipeline is positive, while lobbying, federal grant opportunities, material 8-K events, and news flow are weak or negative [P3]. Persistence is uncertain because the signal spans seven sources but currently depends heavily on congressional buying, while news velocity is slowing and news acceleration is negative [P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed the improvement: 60-day relative strength is -5.69%, although activity is only modestly ahead of price and the theme remains in a forming stage [P1][P2][P4]. MONITOR until improvement extends beyond congressional activity or price begins to confirm.
assessments.rationale_zh: 综合现实活动正在改善，加速度为1.436，但来源之间分化明显：国会议员净买入较强，监管进程偏正面，而游说、联邦拨款机会、重大8-K事件和新闻流均偏弱或为负 [P3]。该信号覆盖七类来源，但目前较依赖国会议员买入；同时新闻速度放缓、加速度为负，因此持续性仍不确定 [P3][P5]。价格尚未确认，过去60天相对大盘落后5.69%，且现实活动领先价格的幅度很小，主题仍处于形成阶段 [P1][P2][P4]。建议继续观察，等待改善扩散到更多活动来源或价格转强。
assessments.rationale_plain: Activity around AI-chip companies is showing early improvement, led mainly by congressional buying and some movement in the regulatory pipeline. However, lobbying, federal funding opportunities, company event filings, and news activity remain weak, so the pickup does not yet look broadly durable. Share prices have lagged the market by about 5.7% over the past 60 days; keep watching for improvement across more sources or a sustained price recovery before acting.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 人工智能芯片相关活动开始出现早期改善，主要由国会议员买入和监管进程推动。不过，游说活动、联邦资金机会、公司重大事项披露和新闻热度仍然偏弱，因此这轮回升能否持续尚不明确。相关股票过去60天相对大盘落后约5.7%，现阶段宜继续观察，等待更多现实活动同步改善或价格持续转强。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that aggregate activity acceleration is already strong across a seven-source framework while congressional buying is elevated, and weak relative price performance could leave room for catch-up if the forming divergence develops [P1][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the narrative if subsequent readings show positive contributions from several currently weak sources—especially lobbying, federal grant opportunities, material 8-K events, or news flow—while 60-day relative performance turns positive [P3][P4][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the narrative if fused activity acceleration turns negative or congressional buying normalizes without improvement in other sources, particularly if relative price performance remains negative [P3][P4].

assessments.name: AI Semiconductors

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across all three tracked sources: Congress net buying is below trend, lobbying is sharply depressed, and material 8-K events are also below trend [P3]. The theme is classified as fading, with activity substantially lagging price [P1][P2], while 60-day relative performance remains positive [P4]; this negative divergence suggests price is running ahead of the underlying activity. The absence of a news leg removes another potential source of near-term reinforcement [P5]. Avoid until the multi-source activity signals recover and begin confirming price.
assessments.rationale_zh: 三个受监测来源的现实活动均偏弱：国会净买入低于趋势，游说活动显著低迷，重大8-K事件也低于趋势[P3]。该主题正处于消退阶段，活动明显落后于价格[P1][P2]，但过去60天的相对表现仍为正[P4]，说明价格可能跑在基本活动之前。当前也没有新闻推动因素提供短期支撑[P5]，因此应等待多个活动来源同步复苏并确认价格走势。
assessments.rationale_plain: Political buying, lobbying activity, and material company disclosures are all running below trend, with lobbying especially weak. Prices have nevertheless outperformed the market over the past 60 days, so enthusiasm appears to be ahead of the activity that would support it. With no fresh news catalyst, the prudent course is to stay away until several activity measures recover together.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政治人士买入、游说活动和公司重大披露都低于趋势，其中游说活动尤其疲弱。过去60天价格仍跑赢大盘，说明市场热情可能已经超过现实活动所能支撑的程度。眼下也没有新的消息催化剂，因此更稳妥的做法是暂时回避，等待多项活动指标同步回升。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that the fused activity acceleration is positive across three sources [P3], and price has shown positive 60-day relative strength [P4]; together these could be early signs of stabilization before the individual source readings turn positive.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the AVOID call if the next update still shows all three source-level activity readings below trend while relative price strength remains positive, preserving the activity-behind-price divergence established in [P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if at least two of the three activity sources turn positive and the radar moves out of its fading negative-divergence condition, especially if price strength remains positive [P1][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Silver Miners

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across all four measured sources: government contracts -1.357, congressional net buying -1.281, lobbying -0.979, and material 8-K events -0.252 [P3]. Durability is poor because the theme is classified as fading and activity materially trails price [P1][P2], although positive fused acceleration leaves a modest possibility of stabilization [P3]. Continuity is especially weak: 60-day relative strength is positive while the activity-price divergence is sharply negative, indicating that price has run ahead of observable activity [P2][P4]. With no supporting news leg, the narrative lacks an additional catalyst [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 四项现实活动指标全部偏弱：政府合同、国会议员净买入、游说投入和重大8-K事件均低于常态 [P3]。该主题已进入衰退阶段，活动明显落后于价格，因此持续性较差；不过综合活动增速转正，仍存在小幅企稳可能 [P1][P2][P3]。过去60天价格相对大盘走强，但现实活动没有跟上，而且没有新闻催化支持，说明市场表现可能已跑在基本活动之前 [P2][P4][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracts, congressional buying, lobbying activity, and major corporate disclosures are all running below their usual levels. Prices have nevertheless outperformed the market over the past 60 days, so investor enthusiasm appears to be ahead of observable activity. With no supporting news catalyst, it is prudent to stay away unless the real-world indicators begin improving together.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同、国会议员买入、游说投入和重大公司披露目前都低于通常水平。尽管如此，相关公司股价过去60天仍跑赢大盘，说明投资热度已经领先于现实活动。由于没有新闻催化支持，较稳妥的做法是暂时回避，等待多项现实指标同步改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that fused activity acceleration is positive across four sources and price has positive 60-day relative strength, which could mark an early turn before source-level readings recover [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the avoidance call if the next readings keep most source-level activity measures negative while relative price strength remains positive or begins to weaken [P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if multiple activity sources turn positive together, fused acceleration remains positive, and price strength persists or improves with a new supporting news leg [P3][P4][P5].

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward emerging activity-led Space Economy and semiconductor themes, while Cybersecurity remains the sole mature confirmed-up leader; energy, health care, metals, broad tech, and crypto are fading or confirmed down.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正轮动至由实体活动领先的太空经济与半导体主题，网络安全则是唯一成熟且已确认上行的领涨方向；能源、医疗、金属、广义科技与加密资产正在走弱或已确认下行。

AI Neoclouds & HPC Hosting; Nuclear & SMR Power; Uranium & Nuclear Fuel; Critical Minerals & Rare Earths; Memory, HBM & Storage; Non-AI Tech & Hardware; Utilities (Equal-Weight); Magnificent Seven; Crypto & Digital Assets — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading: activity and price jointly confirm deterioration.
watch: POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE themes changing to CONFIRMED_UP would validate broader new leadership; reversal to QUIET or NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE would invalidate accumulation.
Cybersecurity losing CONFIRMED_UP would remove the only mature confirmed leader.
NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE themes recovering to CONFIRMED_UP would signal activity catching up with price.
CONFIRMED_DOWN AI infrastructure-adjacent themes—AI Neoclouds, Memory/HBM, and power-related groups—turning positive would indicate renewed AI-capex breadth.
QUIET themes developing POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE or CONFIRMED_UP would reveal the next rotation leg.
